description: The best-documented monument in this pass; obtained from the National Guard at North Canton Ohio in April 1996 with the park opening in 1997; bought by the Army December 1965 and flown in Vietnam by the 173rd Assault Helicopter Company; shot down August 1967 and returned to the United States for repair then later at Fort Sill and flight training units; patched bullet holes are still visible; painted in the markings of the 176th Assault Helicopter Company 14th Combat Aviation Battalion Americal Division at Chu Lai which is not its own unit because the marker honours the 176th's dead; the airframe wears the bare number 587 on the tail; currency evidence is four photographs dated 20 April 2022
